acceptance: CLI test: `report import` of real bundles, then `report rankings`, lists the passing runs
All validation-status filters in database.py are case-insensitive or read normalized values; existing databases are migrated
context: Found 2026-10-14 during the core execution-variants remediation, while making trend and regression rows accept lowercase status in #2944. That PR fixed trends and regressions only.
description:
## Problem
- The result summary lowercases the validation status (`benchbox/core/results/schema.py:396`). `benchbox report import` is the only way rows enter the results database, so the stored status is always `passed`.
- The ranking filter is case-sensitive: `AND validation_status = 'PASSED'` (`benchbox/core/results/database.py:656`). The same mismatch is at `:512-514`, while `:774` already uses `UPPER()`.
- Result: `benchbox report import ./results` then `benchbox report rankings` prints nothing (`cli/commands/report.py:106`). A probe showed only an uppercase row ranked.

## Change
- Normalize `validation_status` when storing, and migrate existing rows.
- Make the filters at `:512` and `:656` case-insensitive, matching `:774`.
